fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (SPCX) receives AI business expansion validation through Anthropic IPO listing, with Wall Street average price target of $267.76 implying 86.6% upside from current levels
fields.summary_ko.1: Anthropic (ANT) is SpaceX's largest AI customer representing over one-third of revenue; IPO priced at $83 and opened at $111.50 showing early strength
fields.summary_ko.2: Following Starship Flight 15 success, Citi analyst raised price target from $240 to $280 and provided long-term target of $900; BofA maintains price target of $275
